About the Team At PointClickCare , our product team is on a mission to transform how providers manage the order lifecycle, combining deep domain expertise with a relentless focus on outcomes that matter.

We operate at the intersection of clinical workflows and technology, building products that directly impact the accuracy, timeliness, and safety of orders for residents, caregivers, and the providers who serve them.

You're comfortable engaging directly with customers, collaborating across teams to solve meaningful problems, and bringing a natural curiosity and growth mindset to continuously improve outcomes and maximize value.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of strategy and execution - someone who can translate complexity into clarity, turn insight into action, and consistently deliver meaningful value for customers.

If you're energized by complex problems, motivated by purpose, and ready to shape what AI-powered order management looks like in senior care – you could be a great fit.

Position Summary: The Product Manager position will be responsible for the successful delivery of products and functionality including migration tooling, onboarding tools and clinical workflows to support senior care buildings in all things orders management.

You will create compelling value for users and customers while driving strategic growth for the business. This role contributes to the product roadmap and balances both tactical execution and strategic planning across their product portfolio.

Product Managers are accountable for product outcomes, using customer insights, data, regulatory considerations, and business objectives to guide decision-making.

The role also focuses on identifying opportunities to modernize and enhance established products through AI, automation, and intelligent workflows that improve customer experiences and operational efficiency. Key Responsibilities:
Own product strategy, roadmap planning, and execution for your portion of orders related products, ensuring alignment with customer needs, market opportunities, and business goals.
Manage products through the full product lifecycle, from discovery, strategy, and prioritization through delivery, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.
Drive product decisions using customer feedback, market research, product analytics, regulatory requirements, and business value rather than solely responding to feature requests.
Serve as the subject matter expert for assigned product areas, developing a deep understanding of product functionality, customer workflows, and the value delivered to end users.
Partner closely with Engineering, Design, Customer Success, Sales, Marketing, and other stakeholders to translate customer needs into meaningful product outcomes.
Serve as the voice of the customer to a scrum team(s) and maintain a prioritized backlog of requirements and other artifacts to support engineering teams in delivering on product priorities.
Assess product investment opportunities and incoming requests with thoughtful, data-informed analysis, providing clear recommendations to leadership and key stakeholders.
Identify opportunities to modernize legacy products through AI capabilities, automation, and smarter workflows that increase customer value and efficiency.
Navigate complex healthcare, clinical, and regulatory environments and translate that knowledge into practical product direction and prioritization.
Understand company strategy and ensure product plans support broader organizational objectives and long-term growth.

Bachelor's degree in Healthcare, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field.
3+ years of product management experience.
Experience managing software products through the full development lifecycle.
Strong background in healthcare IT, clinical workflows, pharmacy systems, or regulatory systems.
Ability to influence and align engineering, design, and business stakeholders without formal authority.
Comfort working with technical concepts, including APIs, integrations, modern software development practices, and platform-based solutions.
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Experience building, launching, or integrating AI/ML-powered product capabilities.
Demonstrated success revitalizing, enhancing, or modernizing legacy products.

About the Team Voice AI is one of ServiceNow 's fastest-growing Now Assist capabilities: intelligent voice agents that resolve customer interactions end-to-end.

The platform is already in production with marquee customers and scaling fast, competing head-to-head against well-funded startups and CCaaS incumbents on the dimensions buyers test most, conversational quality, containment, and reliability.

About the role ServiceNow is looking for a Principal Product Manager to lead the conversational core of its Voice AI platform. This is a rare combination: a product already validated in production with enterprise customers, paired with the mandate and scope of a true 0→1 builder.

The team is on an aggressive growth trajectory, scaling from a handful of live customers today toward 100 within the next year. For an agentic AI product leader who wants ownership of a fast-moving, technically deep product with a clear path to market impact, this is that role. What You'll Own
The conversational core of the Voice AI platform — dialog quality, LLM selection, and evaluation.
The emerging voice-to-voice model integration and deployment strategy.
The customer-enablement motion that lets enterprises design and ramp their own voice agents.
Why this role matters
Own a category-defining product at an inflection point, already live with marquee customers and scaling aggressively, with the growth trajectory and executive visibility of a flagship initiative.
Shape the roadmap for voice-to-voice model integration as the technology itself is still being defined. Genuine 0→1 latitude inside an enterprise platform with real distribution.
Compete directly against the best-funded startups and CCaaS incumbents in the market, with the resources and reach of ServiceNow 's Now Assist platform behind you.
Sit at the center of both the product and the customer, owning enablement as well as the core conversational engine, rather than a narrow slice of either.
What Success Looks Like
Scaling the Voice AI platform's live customer base from a small handful today to roughly 100 within the next year.
Measurable improvement in conversational quality, containment, and reliability. The dimensions enterprise buyers evaluate most closely.
A voice-to-voice model integration and deployment strategy that keeps pace with a fast-moving technology landscape.

8-10+ years of product management experience, recent hands-on experience shipping voice AI products in the last 12–18 months. Years of PM tenure matter far less than what you've shipped recently and how deep you've gone technically.
Fluency with voice stack: ASR, TTS, speech-to-speech, streaming, latency, endpointing, barge-in, turn-taking, noise handling.
Telephony fluency: SIP, call transfers, Amazon Connect, Genesys, Twilio, or similar CCaaS platforms.
Experience defining voice-specific evaluations (task completion, latency, transcription accuracy, interruptions, conversational quality).
Strong technical background in conversational AI and real-time interactions.
Depth in LLM model evaluation for conversational use cases.
Proven experience in AI customer enablement — helping enterprise customers design and ramp their own solutions.
A track record of driving 0→1 innovations from early product to scale.
Experience with telephony and real-time media signaling in a voice AI context.

SKALAR – Wir bauen die digitale Steuerkanzlei der Zukunft
Radikal einfach. Voll digital. 100% mandantenfokussiert.
Wir denken Steuerberatung komplett neu: einfacher, schneller und transparenter für Mandanten und Kanzleiteam zugleich.
Wo andere Kanzleien mit manuellen Prozessen, langen Wartezeiten und intransparenter Kommunikation kämpfen, bauen wir ein völlig neues Erlebnis - digital, proaktiv, KI-gestützt. Mit automatisierten Prozessen im Hintergrund und digitalen Schnittstellen zum Mandanten laufen repetitive Aufgaben weitgehend von selbst - damit du Zeit hast für das, was wirklich zählt: anspruchsvolle Beratung, Sonderfälle und strategische Mandantenfragen.
Der Unterschied zu anderen "Digitalkanzleien": Über die Hälfte unseres Teams sind Softwareentwickler. Du gestaltest direkt mit, was sie bauen - und damit, wie KI-gestützte Steuerberatung in dieser Branche überhaupt aussehen wird. Dein Steuerwissen prägt das Produkt, nicht nur dessen Anwendung.
Wir sind ein erfahrenes Gründerteam aus Steuerberatern, Digital-Unternehmern und Softwareentwicklern mit einem Exit-Track-Record von 140 Mio. €. Mit dir gemeinsam möchten wir eine der führenden Kanzleien Deutschlands aufbauen.
Deine Mission
KI-Features liefern, die Zahlen bewegen: Du verantwortest KI-Features end-to-end – Belegerkennung, Klassifizierung, automatisches Verfassen von Steuer-Antwortschreiben, RAG über Mandantenakten. Du baust die Eval-Frameworks, fährst die Prompt-Iterationen und triffst die Build-vs-Buy-Entscheidungen zu Modellen und Tooling. Keine Übergaben, keine Ausreden.
Werde besessen vom Nutzer: Du betreibst Discovery auf die harte Tour: Interviews, Shadowing-Sessions, Synthese von Rohfeedback. Du gehst tief genug, um echte von angenommenen Problemen zu unterscheiden – und wirst zur schärfsten Stimme des Nutzers in deiner Produktlinie.
Verantworte die Roadmap, verteidige die Trade-offs: Du verantwortest die Roadmap deiner Produktlinie end-to-end. Priorisierung über Geschäftswert, technische Machbarkeit und regulatorische Passung. Du kommunizierst Trade-offs klar an Engineering, Steuerberatung und Gründer – und verteidigst deine Entscheidungen mit Daten.
Halte die Messlatte beim Design: Du setzt einen hohen visuellen Standard und schützt ihn. Figma-Souveränität auf Review- und Skizzen-Niveau: Du entwirfst Flows, kritisierst Komponenten und blockst alles ab, was den Standard nicht erfüllt. Die beste Steuer-UX ist unsichtbar – mach unsere unsichtbar.
Laufe auf Daten, nicht auf Bauchgefühl: Du definierst die KPIs, die zählen – Time-to-Filing, Automatisierungsrate, Mandantenzufriedenheit, Berater-Effizienz – und steuerst jede Iteration aus Dashboards. Bauchgefühl bringt hier keine Features in Produktion.
Treibe die KI-Frontier: Du folgst der KI-Debatte nicht – du treibst sie. Evals, Prompt-Iteration, Kosten-Qualitäts-Trade-offs in Produktion. Du experimentierst unermüdlich mit dem Möglichen und bringst die Speerspitze ins Produkt.
Sei das Bindegewebe: Du sitzt zwischen Engineering, Steuerberatung und Mandanten und machst die Organisation dadurch schneller. First-Principles-Denken.
Dein Profil
Produkterfahrung: 3–6 Jahre Produktmanagement in B2B-SaaS, FinTech, Finance, Tax oder einem vergleichbar komplexen Umfeld. Du kannst auf Features verweisen, die du von der Vision bis zur messbaren Wirkung verantwortet hast – nicht auf Features, an denen du mitgewirkt hast.
KI-Track-Record: Mindestens ein KI-/LLM-Feature in Produktion ausgeliefert – mit echten Evals, Prompt-Iteration und Verantwortung für Kosten-Qualitäts-Trade-offs. Solides Verständnis moderner LLM-Stacks: RAG, Prompt Engineering, Fine-Tuning vs. In-Context-Learning, Vektor-Stores. ChatGPT-Prompts zählen nicht – wir wollen KI-native Workflows, die du tatsächlich gebaut hast.
Mandanten-Empathie, die sich übersetzt: Echte Empathie für beide Seiten – den Berater unter Fristendruck und den Mandanten, der einfach Sicherheit will – und die Disziplin, diese Empathie in Produktentscheidungen zu übersetzen, nicht in Backlog-Items.
Auge fürs Design: Figma-Souveränität auf Skizzen- und Review-Niveau. Klare Meinungen dazu, wie gute UI aussieht, und null Toleranz für schlampige Interfaces. Begeisterung für Claude Design ist ein Plus.
KI-Begeisterung: Du nutzt KI-Produkte täglich, kritisierst sie öffentlich oder privat und hast scharfe Ansichten dazu, wohin sie sich entwickeln. Praktische Vertrautheit mit Claude Cowork/Design/Code, GPT, Gemini o. Ä. ist die Baseline.
Selbst-Umsetzung: Du wartest nicht darauf, entblockt zu werden. Du prototypst, testest Prompts, verdrahtest Integrationen, hackst zusammen, was nötig ist. Wenn etwas blockiert ist, entblockst du es.
Strukturiertes Denken: MECE, First Principles, hypothesengetrieben. Du verdichtest Ambiguität zu klaren Entscheidungen – nicht zu weiteren Foliensätzen.
Kommunikation: Exzellentes Englisch (C2). Deutsch ist ein starkes Plus.
Domänen-Hintergrund: Erfahrung in Finance, Tax, Accounting oder angrenzenden Domänen ist ein starkes Plus – ebenso Vertrautheit mit Accounting-/Finance-Software-Stacks, DATEV, ELSTER oder regulierten Datenworkflows.

Heidi operates across US, UK, Australia and beyond — and integrations are the connective tissue that makes it work everywhere. This PM role is a central platform function: the common layer through which every Heidi product (Scribe, Comms, Evidence) interfaces with the external systems clinicians already live in.
EMRs. Scheduling systems. Document stores. Clinical references. Secure messaging. Wherever clinicians already work, Heidi should plug in without making them think.
The integration stack is real and in motion: SMART on FHIR launches inside the chart, structured write-back into Epic, Cerner, Athena, MEDITECH Expanse, Veradigm, Best Practice. HL7 ADT feeds for patient demographics. Pre-charting from appointment data. The Integration Marketplace — surfacing Scribe, Comms and Evidence integrations in one place — is being rebuilt now, and you’ll own where it goes next.
You’ll own the integration framework, the customer-facing marketplace, and the roadmap that decides which connector ships next and how deep it goes. A small dedicated engineering squad sits alongside you. A new integration framework is rolling out. The marketplace is being unified across product lines. You’re picking up a running operation with strong opinions about where it goes.
Half your time is building the platform — the framework, the standards, the shared infrastructure every connector benefits from. The other half is customer-facing enablement: working directly with accounts, regional teams and commercial to get integrations live and keep them healthy.

The hard part is that every customer feels bespoke, three regional teams are always pulling in different directions, and real EMR behaviour rarely matches the spec. You’ll need to hold the line between configuring for one account and building for the platform.
You need to understand how a real EMR write-back actually works — encounter IDs, appointment IDs, patient context, addendum vs edit, side-by-side comparison, sectional mapping, the lookup tables that break in v1.0.2 of the desktop app.

You need to know when a customer request is a one-account fix and when it’s a framework change that touches every EMR. You need to be the person engineering trusts to call the build-vs-configure trade-off, and the person commercial trusts when they’re scoping integration requirements into a contract.

Über uns
Bei VREY bauen wir das EnergyOS für Mehrfamilienhäuser .
In Deutschland stehen über 3,3 Millionen Mehrparteienhäuser – und sie sind das schwarze Loch der Energiewende. <1% Solardurchdringung. <2% Smart Metering. Kaum Flexibilität oder intelligentes Energiemanagement.
Gleichzeitig zwingt die Regulierung Eigentümer zu massiven Investitionen: Solar wird zur Pflicht, Smart Meter müssen in den nächsten 5 Jahren flächendeckend ausgerollt werden, Heizung und Mobilität elektrifizieren sich. Das Mehrfamilienhaus wird vom Betongold zum aktiven Teil der dezentralen Energieinfrastruktur.
Was fehlt, ist ein integriertes System, das diesen Wandel wirtschaftlich und operativ beherrschbar macht.
VREY kombiniert zertifizierten Messstellenbetrieb mit eigener Software und ermöglicht Eigentümern erstmals, ihren selbst erzeugten Solarstrom direkt an ihre Mieter zu verkaufen – einfach und ohne selbst zum Energieversorger zu werden (§42b EnWG).
Damit wird regulatorischer Zwang zu einer profitablen und planbaren Chance:
Zweistellige Renditen und Wertsteigerung für Eigentümer,
~20 % Stromkostenersparnis für Mieter, und
digitale Infrastruktur für Speicher, Wärmepumpen und Flexibilität.
Bereits heute betreuen wir eine dreistellige Anzahl an Projekten - darunter die größten Bestandshalter und Wohnungsbaugenossenschaften - in allen 16 Bundesländern. Damit gehören wir nach kürzester Zeit zu den führenden Anbietern im Markt.
Im Zuge unserer Seed-Finanzierung haben wir 3,3 Mio. € von führenden Impact- und Energy-VCs (u. a. Rubio Impact Ventures, HTGF, Kopa Ventures) eingesammelt. Mit dem frischen Kapital gehen wir in die nächste Wachstumsphase und bauen unser Team gezielt aus.
Wir stehen am Anfang eines strukturellen Marktumbruchs. Wer heute die Energieinfrastruktur im Mehrfamilienhaus definiert, prägt sie für Jahrzehnte. Werde Teil von VREY und baue mit uns das führende EnergyOS.

Nium provides global infrastructure for real-time cross-border payments. We were founded on the mission to deliver the global payments infrastructure of tomorrow, today. Our platform enables banks, fintechs, and global businesses to move money instantly, everywhere.
Co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore with offices in 14 markets worldwide, we are entering one of the most exciting chapters in our journey. In March 2026, we delivered the largest month in our 11-year history with record revenue, record volumes, and EBITDA profitability. Today, Nium moves nearly $60B in payments annually, almost entirely for enterprises, while continuing to strengthen an already healthy balance sheet.
It is an incredible time to join us, and we are only just getting started.
Our payout network spans 190+ countries and 100 currencies, with 100 + corridors in real time. We power seamless transfers to accounts, wallets, and cards, support local collections in 35 markets, and as a principal card issuer on Visa, Mastercard, Discover, and UATP, Nium issues over 50 million card tokens every year.

Backed by regulatory licenses in 40+ markets, we make it simple for our partners to onboard, integrate, and scale globally.

This scale and innovation have earned us recognition as one of CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025, winner of Best Cross-Border Payments Solution at the PayTech Awards, and inclusion in FXC Intelligence’s Top 100 Cross-Border Payments Companies list.
In 2024, we raised US$50 million in Series E funding at a US$1.4 billion valuation to accelerate network expansion, product innovation, and talent growth. With the B2B payments market projected to hit US$175 trillion by 2030, Nium offers ambitious builders the chance to shape the future of global money movement with the scale of a leader and the energy of a high-growth company.

When a contractor in Brazil gets paid on time, a business in Singapore settles in the right currency, or a payroll platform moves money to 40 countries without a single failure: that's what a good payments platform looks like from the outside. From the inside, it's hard decisions about which rails to build on, what reliability means at scale, and how to make a platform handling billions a month behave consistently across markets with completely different rules.
Nium processes cross-border payments for banks, fintechs, and enterprise platforms across 100+ countries. The Senior PM - Payments Platform owns the rails those payments run on.

Reliability. Define what "good" looks like for corridor performance, settlement success, and straight-through processing. Set the targets, own them, move them.

Corridor and market design . Each market has its own mechanics and failure modes. You translate that into requirements: what the corridor supports, how failure is handled, what go-live looks like, so the products built on top can make promises to customers and keep them.

Integration standards. You set the bar for what gets built with correspondent banks, local networks, and processors globally. You decide which integrations are worth doing, weighing partner economics and business impact against build and maintenance cost, and you push the ones that matter through to delivery.

Resilience. Design for failure: redundancy, failover, degraded modes. The goal is a platform where a single rail going down doesn't mean customers feel it.

AI and agentic payment flows . This is the frontier. Payments infrastructure today is reactive: something breaks, someone fixes it. We want infrastructure that thinks: routes intelligently, detects degradation before customers feel it, reconciles autonomously, resolves failures without human escalation. Nium wants to be the first payments infrastructure company to make agentic flows core to how money moves. You define what that looks like and build it.

Payments experience at real scale: high volume, multi-market, genuine accountability when things break. You understand the mechanics (settlement windows, return codes, reconciliation, failure handling) well enough to bring unambiguous requirements.

Curious about how payments work across markets. AI-native in how you work. Rigorous about prioritization. Opinionated, not passive: you form a point of view on how a corridor or integration should work, and you push it forward rather than waiting to be told what to build.

You push Engineering on trade-offs and bring them along with you, holding ground on what's right for the corridor and the business without needing positional authority to do it. And above all, you are passionate about the customer outcome at the end of the transaction, not the platform for its own sake.

3-5 years in product management. Payments, fintech, or financial infrastructure is a requirement. Experience with real-time rails (UPI, SEPA, RTP, Pix, or equivalents) is a strong plus.

The Opportunity

Most payments PMs work on one market, one rail, one product type. Here you work on all of them simultaneously: Asia-Pacific, Americas, Europe, MENA, all with different mechanics and failure modes. The exposure you get in two years compresses what usually takes a decade.

The team is small, senior, and ambitious. The infrastructure you build will process tens of billions of dollars a month and affect the finances of real people and businesses, including the first generation of payments that run through AI agents rather than human-initiated flows.

How We’ll Measure You

Corridor success rate and STP rate, moved quarter over quarter.

Settlement failure rate and time-to-resolution.

Integration delivery against committed dates.

Reduction in payment failures from platform-layer decisions.

That discipline built the licences, banking relationships, custody and compliance machinery that the next era of this market will run on
The financial system is moving on-chain. Stablecoins are the only digital asset class operating at institutional scale today, and while 98% of supply is dollar-pegged, roughly half of global payment flows are not. That gap is the opportunity, and it is largest in exactly the markets Luno has spent twelve years building in.

You will join the Product Management team building Luno’s institutional business: the activation, digital asset account infrastructure and issuance products that let businesses, institutions and partners operate on Luno’s rails. The portfolio spans Luno Institutional and BlockTower, the group’s stablecoin issuance business. You'll report to the Group Product Manager and work in the BlockTower pod with dedicated engineering and UX partners.

BlockTower is the group’s institutional stablecoin issuance business, starting with ZARU, the South African rand stablecoin.

You'll own the products institutions touch: the self-service issuance platform, where treasury teams mint, redeem, distribute yield and report, and Wallet as a Service, which lets those institutions use and offer stablecoins inside their own products and flows.

Your job is to turn a working product into a repeatable one, and to build the foundation on which future local-currency stablecoins launch in new markets.

The issuance platform: the portal, mint and redeem flows, yield distribution, user and access management, approval workflows, statements and reporting
Wallet as a Service: how institutions embed wallets into their own platforms

Repeatability: the next currency, chain, market or wallet use case should be a configuration exercise, not a new build
Commercial shape: Take institutional customers live and convert every manual step in their journey into a self-service product
Customer-centric: Spend real time with the customers themselves: treasury teams, payment providers, market makers and financial institutions, and let their operating reality shape the roadmap
Build the controls institutions require to trust an issuer: auditability, segregation of duties, and reporting that their own compliance teams will accept

You are comfortable operating a young business inside a larger group: small team, broad remit, decisions made with limited information and a parent company whose infrastructure you depend on

Voulez-vous vivre cette dynamique avec nous et emprunter de nouvelles voies ? Rejoignez une équipe qui valorise non seulement l'expertise professionnelle, mais aussi une communication ouverte et une confiance mutuelle.
Vous êtes passionné par...
* la responsabilité globale des produits techniques sur la plateforme de services métier orientée vers l'avenir, y compris la planification et le suivi du budget, la conception des produits et leur développement
* l'élaboration des besoins des différentes parties prenantes (internes et externes) et appréciez le rôle d'interface entre elles
* la planification et la priorisation des projets de développement au-delà des frontières des départements et des projets
* l'organisation d'événements clients et le lancement de nouveaux produits ainsi que la conception de documents et formats pertinents pour la vente
* l'identification des potentiels de vente croisée et additionnelle, y compris l'assurance des possibilités d'intégration dans d'autres produits et groupes de produits
* la détection précoce des tendances technologiques et leur traduction en opportunités et risques - avec un regard sur la prospective technologique et la gestion de la confiance
Vous nous enthousiasmez...
* par votre longue et vaste expérience en gestion de produits informatiques et votre engagement à réaliser des visions produit
* par vos connaissances techniques informatiques approfondies, qui vous permettent de comprendre les interconnexions en détail, ainsi que par votre grand intérêt pour le changement technologique (prospective)
* avec une formation supérieure achevée en informatique ou plusieurs années d'expérience professionnelle avec une formation continue correspondante en gestion de produit ou d'innovation
* si vous aimez évoluer dans un environnement (agile) de différentes disciplines et compétences
* par votre capacité de communication adaptée au public - du technique au niveau C
* avec vos compétences en allemand à un niveau courant (C1) et en anglais au niveau B2
* avantage : compréhension des bases de la confiance/sécurité telles que la gestion des identités et des accès, PKI/certificats et Zero Trust, etc.
**Rejoignez notre équipe et découvrez les possibilités de vous impliquer professionnellement et sur le fond chez Finnova.**
